Deep Research Engine Documentation

Welcome to the Deep Research Engine documentation. This framework is a high-performance orchestration system for autonomous intelligence, designed to handle complex research workflows, multi-agent collaboration, and recursive knowledge synthesis.

SYSTEM_STATUS_STABLE

Core Objective

To provide a scalable, modular foundation for building research agents that can navigate the web, process multimodal data, and synthesize findings into high-fidelity reports.
